picks.title: Roku Beta Launches AI-Driven Advertising Platform
picks.rationale: New release: Roku Outcomes uses AI to optimize streaming-TV buys for actions like app installs, and all nine beta flights hit target CPA (median 38% below), which makes CTV a performance channel for acquisition budgets.
picks.excerpt: Roku launched Roku Outcomes in beta, an AI-driven platform that optimizes streaming-TV campaigns for actions like app installs; all nine beta flights hit target CPA, with a median 38% below target.

picks.title: The Trade Desk and Dstillery Link AI Agents to Reshape Audiences Mid-Campaign
picks.rationale: New agent-to-agent integration in a major DSP: audiences can be rebuilt while a campaign runs, and buyers say whether this changes media buying is still unproven.
picks.excerpt: The Trade Desk and Dstillery connected their AI agents so audiences can be built and reshaped mid-campaign; buyers like the speed but question whether agentic integrations meaningfully change media buying.

picks.title: Google AI Mode Now With Up To Four Ads
picks.rationale: Follow-up with a concrete change: a single AI Mode answer can now carry up to four Google Ads, which raises the paid inventory inside AI search that advertisers are bidding on.
picks.excerpt: Google can now show up to four Google Ads inside a single AI Mode response, following its earnings-call pledge to show more ads, more often, in AI Mode.

picks.title: TikTok Shop AI estimates extra orders per listing fix ahead of Black Friday
picks.rationale: New seller tools before Black Friday: AI estimates how many extra orders each listing fix would bring, and US sellers get AI-made product videos and photos in minutes.
picks.excerpt: TikTok Shop's AI now estimates how many extra orders each listing fix would bring, and US sellers get AI-made product videos and photos in minutes ahead of Black Friday.

picks.title: Google AI Mode Adds Booking & Quote Links For Home Services
picks.rationale: New lead-gen surface: AI Mode now routes home-service searches straight to partner booking and quote pages, which changes how local businesses get (and may pay for) leads.
picks.excerpt: Google AI Mode now links home-service searches straight to booking and quote pages through partners, raising questions about lead fees for local businesses.
